description: This file defines a durable, serializable dictionary implementation in C# for use within the Orleans framework, including interfaces, classes, and debug views for state management and serialization.

classes.name: IDurableDictionary`2
classes.description: A generic interface extending IDictionary for durable, serializable dictionaries.

classes.name: DurableDictionary`2
classes.description: An internal class implementing a durable, serializable dictionary with state machine capabilities, supporting versioned log entries, snapshotting, and change application.

classes.name: DebugViewDictionaryItem`2
classes.description: A debug view struct for dictionary items, providing a formatted display of key-value pairs.

classes.name: IDurableDictionaryDebugView`2
classes.description: A debug view class for inspecting the contents of an IDurableDictionary, used for debugging purposes.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state of the durable dictionary, clearing items and setting the storage writer.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the dictionary state based on serialized commands.

methods.name: ApplySnapshot
methods.description: Applies a snapshot to restore the dictionary state from serialized data.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the dictionary and appends a clear command to the log.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the dictionary.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a key from the dictionary and logs the removal.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the dictionary and logs the addition.

methods.name: ContainsKey
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the dictionary.

methods.name: TryGetValue
methods.description: Attempts to get a value for a key.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over the dictionary.

methods.name: AppendSet
methods.description: Appends a set command to the log for a key-value pair.

methods.name: AppendRemove
methods.description: Appends a remove command to the log for a key.

methods.name: OnSet
methods.description: A virtual method invoked when a key-value pair is set.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the current log writer for appending entries.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the state machine (not implemented).
